build_colmap_and_dependencies: run the build script to compile COLMAP and all dependencies from source with cmake
build_cmake_project: build a cmake project by configuring and installing it to a specified path
build_ceres_solver: build the Ceres solver dependency with optional SuiteSparse and LAPACK support
download_zipfile_with_md5_check: download a zip file from a URL, verify its MD5 hash, and extract it
parse_build_args: parse command line arguments for the COLMAP build script including paths and feature flags
